name: mj359d-cos-dependency-dedupe
goal: Replay the recorded CoS queue and deliver a dependency update once per item and text change.

evidence: Primary Mac CoS transcript shows repeated watchdog deliveries for eight alert rows from 15:30Z onward. Their ids remain unsent. Expect one delivery per item text and digest visibility for open blockers.
The existing delivery test retries only the same alert ids. Extend it with a sanitized recorded eight-row queue and replay a new id for unchanged text; keep no-receipt retry coverage.
At 98193e2938 the unchanged Tracker delivery suite failed because the replay sent two eight-item batches instead of one. Red checkpoint retained by loop record.
Persist receipts per item and full CoS message text. Recover missed tmux acknowledgements from bounded same-project Claude prompt or queue receipts.
Frozen test corpus and one command failed at 98193e2938 and passed at ea99e155f1. The PR also exercises transcript receipt recovery in a second test.
